drafted_from: tool:keep-ai-provider-limits' own row (its words, input schema, wake and steps); read the row before relying on it
start_here: Nothing to say: the workflow workflow:keep-ai-provider-limits runs tool:keep-ai-provider-limits, once per start, on the computer that runs the local AI proxy. It sends one tiny call only when no row of that provider was read in the quiet window, and writes the limit headers the proxy returns. To read the rows, say to your AI: "Show the AI limits I have kept."
no_lists_because: The rows are kept in the person's provider_limits table; the tool itself keeps nothing.
instructions: 1. Leave it on: the workflow runs the tool with its store filled from the signed-in account's default store row (account_stores). Its proxy address, model and quiet window are written in the workflow's step, not in this tool.
2. Read each pass: `sent` false means a row of that provider was read inside the quiet window; `sent` true with rows means the headers were written.
3. A status row of unknown means the proxy did not pass the headers; check the proxy's passthrough setting before trusting the rows.

worked_examples.title: Read the kept limits
worked_examples.ask: Show the AI limits I have kept.

input.sql: select provider, account, window_name, used_percent, resets_at, read_at, state from provider_limits order by provider, window_name

worked_examples.hands_back: The rows of the AI limits kept: provider, account, window name, used percent (null for an unknown window), resets at, read at and state (ok or limited), one row per window.
